about: Hand labels of the 10 chunks of the Phase 2 code-switching gate (docs/evidence/phase-2/codeswitch-labels.txt, labelled by the owner by ear, 11 Nov 2026). Time ranges and language labels only: no audio and no transcript text (CoSHE-Eval is CC BY-NC 4.0, evaluation only). 'main' is the language that leads the chunk; 'kind' is 'pure' for one language and 'mixed' for both. These ten chunks are the HELD-OUT final test of Phase 5: tune detection rules on other data (CoSHE chunks outside this list, the local code-switched set), never on these.
